title: Import SRD Spellcasting-rules chapter as rule records
description: The general Spellcasting rules chapter (What Is a Spell, Spell Level, Known/Prepared, Spell Slots, Casting at a Higher Level, Rituals, Casting Time, Components, Range, Areas of Effect, Duration, Targets, Combining Magical Effects) is never sliced: the coreRules anchor ends at 'Spellcasting' and the spell slices start at 'Spell Lists'/'Spell Descriptions', so only the single 'spellcasting-ability' leaf is captured. These rules govern all 319 spells already in the pack. Add a new 'spellcastingRules' section anchor (Spellcasting -> Spell Lists) and emit rule records for it. See docs/audits/srd-5.1-rules-section-coverage.md (loreweaver-ars), section #15 and root cause 2.
close_reason: Added spellcastingRules section anchor (Spellcasting->Spell Lists) and parsed it via the nesting-aware parseRules with a new reservedKeySlugs param to disambiguate the 4 cross-slice title collisions. Pack 127->161 rules; gated by EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_RULE_KEYS. Full suite green.
